summary: Dixit is a party game of visual storytelling where the storyteller gives an evocative clue for one of their surreal, dreamlike cards, and everyone else tries to submit a card from their own hand that could also match. It's beloved for sparking creativity and gentle social deduction with almost no rules overhead.
praised: Very easy to teach, works for all ages and non-gamers
criticised: Can feel repetitive over many plays
Storyteller can be too obvious or too obscure, unbalancing scoring
Groups that don't 'click' creatively can find it flat

interaction.detail: Every round the storyteller's clue and card become shared information that all other players react to by choosing cards and voting, directly affecting each other's scoring chances. There's no personal board; the interaction is entirely social, mediated through card choice and guessing.

scoring.why: Points come from correctly guessing the storyteller's card or fooling others into picking your own, so balancing cleverness and ambiguity decides the winner
scoring.how_you_win: Score points steadily by guessing right as a listener or crafting clues that split the vote as storyteller, and be the first to cross the finish line on the score track.
